description_for_fit: Investment Analyst Junior – Public Equities & M&A Location: Prague Reports to: Investment Directors Role summary We seek an Investment Analyst (2-4 years) to support both a concentrated public equities portfolio and private investment / M&A opportunities. Work will shift between the two areas as priorities change. Working with senior leadership, you will research companies, model valuation and returns, prepare investment committee recommendations, support transaction execution, and monitor investments. Key responsibilities Public Equities Generate differentiated, high-conviction ideas through fundamental research across sectors and geographies; maintain an active idea pipeline and reassess positions as fundamentals evolve. Build rigorous financial models (DCF, comps, scenario analysis) to underwrite valuation, downside, and catalysts. Produce concise, decision-oriented investment memos articulating thesis, risks, and expected returns and investment committee materials. Support portfolio construction and rebalancing through position sizing, exposure analysis (concentration, sector, geography, factor, liquidity), stress tests, and downside scenarios. Conduct drawdown reviews and post-mortems to refine process and improve risk discipline. Track earnings, news flow, and management commentary; flag thesis deviations and recommend action. Maintain clean portfolio analytics, performance attribution, and risk reporting infrastructure. Private Investments & M&A Screen acquisition and minority investment opportunities; assess markets, business models, historical performance, and value drivers. Build operating and transaction models with DCF, trading and deal comps, equity bridges, returns, and downside cases. Prepare valuation analyses, initial and binding offers, and investment committee materials covering deal structure, risks, and returns. Coordinate due diligence with internal teams and external advisers; translate financial, commercial, legal, and tax findings into pricing and deal protections. Support deal execution, including process coordination, review of commercial SPA/SHA terms, financing analysis, and closing preparation. Track private investments against the investment case and support portfolio company reviews and follow-on decisions. Requirements Experience: 2-4 years in investment banking / M&A, private equity, public equities investing, equity research, or asset management, with interest in both listed and private investments. Direct exposure to financial modeling and company valuation; transaction execution or due diligence experience is an advantage. Demonstrated interest in investing, sound commercial judgment, and willingness to switch between public equities and M&A assignments as priorities change. Skills: Strong financial modeling and accounting fluency. Ability to assess business quality, competitive dynamics, and capital allocation. Ability to evaluate deal structure, enterprise-to-equity value bridges, financing, returns, and due diligence findings. Clear, structured communicator with strong written and verbal skills. High analytical rigor and attention to detail. · Tools: Excel/Google Sheets, Capital IQ/Bloomberg/FactSet/Refinitiv, Python/R or equivalent for data analysis (nice to have). · Attributes: Intellectually curious and independent thinker with high integrity, an owner’s mindset, and disciplined long-term judgment, comfortable operating in a lean, high-accountability environment.

Ihre Tasks * Controlling strategisch und operativ steuern: Verantwortung für die Führung des Teams Controlling inklusive Mitarbeiterentwicklung, Ressourcensteuerung, Onboarding sowie Sicherstellung effizienter und reibungsloser Controllingprozesse. * Weiterentwicklung von Controllingprozessen und -systemen: Aktive Gestaltung der fachlichen und technischen Weiterentwicklung des Controllings durch Optimierung und Automatisierung bestehender Prozesse und Systeme sowie den gezielten Einsatz moderner Datenanalysen und KI-basierter Lösungen. * Verantwortung für Forecast und Konzernplanung: Gesamtverantwortung für den monatlichen Forecast von Bilanz und GuV sowie die Konzernplanung inklusive Qualitätssicherung, Konsistenzprüfung und termingerechter Prozesssteuerung. * Analyse und Management-Reporting: Managementgerechte Aufbereitung und Analyse von Planungs-, Forecast- und Konzernergebnissen, Identifikation relevanter Werttreiber, Durchführung von Ursachenanalysen sowie Ableitung und Nachverfolgung geeigneter Maßnahmen. * Verantwortung des Vertriebscontrollings: Konzeption und Ausbau zielgerichteter Controlling- und Reportingsysteme für den Vertrieb unter Berücksichtigung der übergeordneten Steuerungsziele des Unternehmens. * Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Stakeholdern: Enge Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit Accounting, Asset Liability Management, Vertrieb, Tochterbanken, Erste Bank/Group sowie weiteren relevanten Stakeholdern. * Übernahme von Projekten und Sonderaufgaben: Proaktive Bearbeitung von Sonderthemen und Projekten, frühzeitiges Erkennen außergewöhnlicher Entwicklungen sowie Identifikation und Umsetzung von Effizienzsteigerungspotenzialen. Ihr Background * Abgeschlossenes wirtschaftliches Studium, bankenspezifische Controllerausbildung und Führungsausbildung; Ausbildung in Buchhaltung/Bilanzierung sowie Konsolidierung * Profunde Kenntnisse und fundierte Praxiserfahrung im Bankcontrolling * Ausgeprägte Expertise und einschlägige Praxiserfahrung in der Rechnungslegung nach UGB

Läs mer om satsningen och Göteborgs universitet här: https://www.gu.se/node/190161/ Vetenskapsrådet kommer att utlysa en attraktiv finansiering för biträdande universitetslektorer med internationell bakgrund i slutet av 2026. Universitetets ambition är att nominera konkurrenskraftiga kandidater från denna satsning till Vetenskapsrådet. Handelshögskolan vid Göteborgs universitet har cirka 3 700 heltidsstudenter, 470 medarbetare, 160 internationella partneruniversitet och fyra institutioner. Handelshögskolan är Triple Crown-ackrediterad genom EQUIS, AACSB och AMBA. Institutionen för företagsekonomi är Handelshögskolans största institution och bedriver omfattande forskning och utbildning på grundnivå, avancerad nivå och forskarnivå. Anställningen är placerad vid sektionen för Industrial and Financial Management & Logistics (IFEL), som bedriver forskning och utbildning inom bland annat corporate finance och har nära samarbeten med forskningsmiljöer såsom Centre for Finance (CFF), Northern Lead och Lighthouse. Ämne Företagsekonomi med inriktning mot Corporate Finance. Ämnesbeskrivning Corporate Finance behandlar företags finansiella beslutsfattande med fokus på investeringsbeslut, finansieringsstrategier och mekanismer för att säkerställa en marknadsmässig avkastning för både ägare och långivare. Centralt för området är utveckling av teoretiskt och empiriskt grundade ramverk som möjliggör lönsamma investeringar och effektiv finansiering med beaktande av risk och kapitalkostnad. Särskild vikt läggs vid analys av faktorer som påverkar företags val av kapitalstruktur och investeringsstrategier, särskilt i miljöer som präglas av asymmetrisk information och transaktionskostnader. En tydlig förankring i finansiell teori är central för att förstå, förklara och analysera dessa beslut och deras konsekvenser. Ämnesområdet har en stark metodinriktning där kvantitativa verktyg, såsom diskonteringsmodeller, reala och finansiella optionsmodeller samt statistiska och ekonometriska metoder, används för att analysera hur externa marknadsförhållanden påverkar företags finansiella beslut. Arbetsuppgifter Anställningen omfattar högst 50 procent undervisning och minst 50 procent forskning. Forskningen ska huvudsakligen bedrivas inom Corporate Finance, ligga i linje med ämnesbeskrivningen ovan och hålla sådan kvalitet att resultaten kan publiceras i högkvalitativa internationella vetenskapliga tidskrifter. Forskningen förväntas också aktivt presenteras och diskuteras vid forskningsseminarier och i akademiska nätverk. Undervisning sker på grundnivå och avancerad nivå, och den anställde förväntas även bidra till forskarutbildning och uppdragsutbildning samt till kursutveckling och administrativa uppgifter. Undervisningen avser främst kurser inom Corporate Finance, exempelvis Corporate Valuation, Advanced Corporate Finance och Financial Management eller motsvarande kurser, samt handledning av kandidat- och masteruppsatser inom finans och Accounting and Financial Management. title: Financial Reporting Specialist
description_for_fit: Nordic Investin is recruiting a Financial Reporting Specialist on behalf of one of our partner companies. You can turn a complex reporting requirement into a repeatable process and a result that leaders can trust. The partner is improving external and internal financial reporting across a multi entity organisation. You will prepare reporting packages, coordinate inputs and strengthen the controls and explanations behind key figures and disclosures. The finance environment values accuracy, traceability and practical improvement. Work should withstand review, make ownership clear and reduce the recurring manual effort or uncertainty that weakens later reporting and decisions. How you will work You will collaborate across entity finance, shared services and business teams while owning defined parts of the financial cycle. The partner expects issues to be investigated to root cause, conclusions to be documented and improvements to remain workable at the next close. As a specialist, you will own a defined professional area and be trusted to move work forward independently. You are expected to recognise when a question requires wider expertise, explain recommendations clearly and improve the methods or tools used by colleagues around you. What you will do Prepare periodic financial reporting and disclosure schedules. Coordinate reporting inputs across entities and functions. Analyse movements and validate supporting evidence. Maintain reporting instructions, calendars and controls. Support annual reports, audits and management presentations. Improve reporting templates, systems and data quality. What you will bring Experience in financial reporting, group accounting or audit. Strong accounting and analytical foundation. Ability to manage detailed deadlines across contributors. Advanced spreadsheet and reporting system capability. Excellent documentation and review discipline. Professional English and high quality financial writing. Experience that would add value IFRS disclosure preparation. European sustainability reporting exposure. Consolidation or narrative reporting systems. A background that can succeed here You may come from audit, statutory reporting, group accounting or a finance function with complex management reporting. The partner values someone who understands both the figure and the evidence chain required to support it. What makes the opportunity interesting The role places you close to information used by executives, boards and external stakeholders. You will improve not only the final report, but the process and confidence that sit behind it. The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time. The recruitment conversation During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional credential if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap. How to apply Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant organisation, service, project or financial process you have helped improve.
